svg.title: Proposed timing around installed Agency prompting and PLANNED Azure
svg.desc: Ask, snapshot, setup readiness, launcher dispatch, text and rendering are separate observation points. The successful Agency smoke records process elapsed time only, not these proposed GUI timing stages or a model benchmark.
